children.value: > Fact From Story The U.S. Justice Department filed an antitrust suit against Google for monopolizing digital ad technologies.
> > Fact From Story The anticompetitive effects of Google’s scheme cause profound harm to competition, to consumers, to labor, and to a democratic free press.
> > > Fact From Story The 2020 Justice Department’s civil antitrust suit was over search and search advertising
> > > Fact From Story The case arrives alongside the filing of the U.S. Justice Department’s lawsuit against Google for monopolizing digital ad technologies
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Digital ad technologies, search, and search advertising are all markets that can be monopolized.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Monopolies are bad for competition and consumers.
> Commonsense Knowledge Antitrust laws are designed to prevent monopolies and promote competition.
